name: Darkstalkers vs. Street Fighter Character Production
description: DS vs. SF character production using reusable asset, QA, and sign-off gates. Returning Darkstalkers begin from Vampire Savior behavior; Street Fighter characters require complete native Vampire Savior-era what-if reimagining without losing their established identity.

phases.name: DS vs. SF Character Authority
phases.summary: Complete the expanded-Vampire-Savior identity and qualitative authored-depth parity review before signoff.

steps.label: Character is classified as returning Darkstalkers or Street Fighter-side
Source identity and behavior are recorded separately from crossover interpretation
Street Fighter-side design passes the native Vampire Savior-era what-if review
Character has a coherent gameplan, meaningful tools and weaknesses, and purposeful new material
System participation and character-specific exceptions fit the individual fighter
Intros, winposes, taunts, reactions, effects, sounds, transitions, and interactions receive review
Character avoids random move accumulation, superficial effects, and homogenized chain or mobility design
Written review confirms authored-depth, matchup, and production parity with the surrounding Darkstalkers cast without quotas
JustNoPoint approves the native Vampire Savior feel and preserved Street Fighter identity

phases.name: Vampire Savior Foundation v1
phases.summary: Prove a representative Darkstalkers cohort, select remaining coverage only after Morrigan, and freeze a safe DS4 branch snapshot.

steps.label: Demitri completes applicable implementation, evidence, QA, and JustNoPoint signoff
Morrigan completes applicable implementation, evidence, QA, and JustNoPoint signoff
Post-Morrigan coverage-gap review inventories unproven Vampire Savior assumptions
JustNoPoint selects one or possibly two contrasting returning Darkstalkers; identities remain provisional until then
Approved cohort completes applicable implementation, evidence, QA, and signoff
Audit separates reusable mechanisms and VS foundation policy from DS crossover and character content
Freeze and document Vampire Savior Foundation v1 assumptions, supported cases, evidence, gaps, and revision rules
JustNoPoint approves the versioned foundation as safe to branch for the dedicated DS4 pass

phases.name: Street Fighter-Side Source-to-DS Conversion
phases.summary: After Demitri and Morrigan signoff, preserve SFA evidence and convert each SF-side character through reviewed Vampire Savior behavior bands without homogenizing identity or silently copying values.

steps.label: Exact SFA game/revision evidence is captured and preserved separately from DS values
Each move is mapped by semantic role and conditions rather than button strength alone
Demitri/Morrigan comparison coverage and any unsupported archetype assumptions are visible
Tick rate, coordinates, trajectories, facing, camera, and reaction meanings are normalized
Hit pause, reactions, velocities, chains/cancels, collision, damage, resources, and presentation receive reviewed proposals
Optional Auto-Apply Conversion Drafts records source, prior, formula, proposal, applied value, validation, and undo transaction without stopping between moves
Ambiguous, unsupported, destructive, dependency-incomplete, or manually diverged changes remain queued instead of being auto-applied
AIR, boxes, P2 reaction, hit sparks, trajectories, and cancel windows are compared visually
Applied working drafts are reviewed, revised, or reverted in bulk before QA and character signoff
Whiff, hit, guard, air, corner, cancel, and resource experiments pass with recorded evidence
Source behavior, normalized values, conversion proposals, applied drafts, signed-off values, and deliberate deviations remain separately recorded
JustNoPoint approves Vampire Savior fit, Street Fighter identity, and play feel

phases.name: DS4-first character backport review
phases.summary: When applicable, reinterpret a DS4-origin character for DS rather than copying sequel policy or runtime code.

steps.label: Source-neutral identity/content snapshot and provenance are reviewed
Port record identifies shared identity, DS4-only decisions, DS replacements, retained behavior, and open questions
DS implementation has separate states, constants, effects, sounds, metadata, controls, resources, tests, and balance
No DS4 runtime import, circular dependency, or automatic synchronization remains
Character passes the complete DS authored-depth and crossover completion rubric
JustNoPoint explicitly approves the DS backport independently of DS4 status
